Made for the night.

NIGHTSHIFT is an independent browser racing game. It is not affiliated with Ferrari, Porsche, Lamborghini, Bugatti, TikTok, ByteDance, CSR Racing, or their owners.

Ferrari 458 Italia model

Model by vicent091036, provided through the Three.js car materials example, under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Modified matte paint, materials, plates and lights. This model is used only for the Ferrari. The other three cars use distinct models.

Distinct unlockable cars

2023 Bugatti Chiron Profilee by DisneyCars, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Source distribution optimised/compressed geometry. NIGHTSHIFT centres and scales each model, changes paint to matte, darkens windows and animates wheels at runtime.

Lamborghini Aventador SVJ SDC ( FREE ) by SDC PERFORMANCE™️, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Source distribution optimised/compressed geometry. NIGHTSHIFT centres and scales each model, changes paint to matte, darkens windows and animates wheels at runtime.

Porsche 911 GT3 by ChevroletSS, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Source distribution optimised/compressed geometry. NIGHTSHIFT centres and scales each model, changes paint to matte, darkens windows and animates wheels at runtime.

Optimised GLB distribution: pedrosoandre/carros. Detailed asset records.

TikTok LIVE bridge

Uses the unofficial TikTok-Live-Connector. Live connectivity depends on TikTok and the connector’s signing service. The public web preview includes free simulated taps and gifts. The local Node.js launcher supplies the live bridge. No real gift is sent by the test buttons.
